tools.name: list_brands
tools.description: Returns a brands array with each brand's category, offer and code (if any). Optionally filter by category: crypto-exchange, crypto-card, hardware-wallet, trading-tools, travel-esim, creator-tools, dining, home-design, ai-tools.

tools.name: get_code
tools.description: Returns the full verified-code record for one brand: the code, the benefit, how to apply it, last-verified date, availability notes, and the guide/review URLs. Match by brand name or slug (e.g. 'kraken', 'Bybit Card').

tools.name: search_codes
tools.description: Free-text search across brands, categories and offers, e.g. 'stock perps discount', 'esim', '20% off exchange'. Returns matching verified-code records.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "list_brands" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
